verdict.rationale: Ente's official CLI is documented only for exporting and backing up Auth data and decrypting the export. Nothing shows a CLI command or API that returns a current TOTP code to an agent. Exported secrets could be fed into an external TOTP generator, and the enteauth://search deep link only opens a search, so both are workarounds or adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can fetch a current TOTP code programmatically — via CLI or API — to complete a 2FA login inside an automated workflow
